avis.titre: Instant Hydration & Repair! Love This Ampoule
avis.texte: I was initially drawn to this product because it claimed to help reset the skin’s regeneration cycle. My skin barrier had been completely compromised uneven texture, dull tone, and excessive dryness. At one point, I even avoided washing my face, and when it felt unbearably dry, I overloaded it with moisture, which only led to more breakouts and an endless cycle of skin issues. That’s when I decided to try this ampoule. The texture is quite thick, even more so than a serum, so it might feel heavy when spreading it on the skin. However, it absorbs well when gently patted in. There’s barely any noticeable scent, which I appreciate. Rather than applying a large amount at once, I found that evenly pressing it into the skin worked best. I’ve been using it for nearly two weeks now, which is a bit short to fully experience the 28-day skin regeneration cycle. However, I can already see and feel a difference! Honestly, my skin has recovered so much it’s unbelievable. I’m now at a point where I only need to use it every 2–3 days. My skin barrier feels significantly stronger! The first night I applied it, I woke up the next morning and could immediately feel the difference. It was so effective that I recommended it to a friend, and after just one use, they asked me what it was because they noticed a visible improvement. Highly recommend this product!

avis.titre: Lightweight Yet Deeply Nourishing – Great for Sensitive Skin!
avis.texte: I was pleasantly surprised by the texture of the REJURAN Turnover Ampoule. It has a slight viscosity, similar to a snail ampoule, but without the heavy stickiness. Despite its rich hydration, the formula feels surprisingly lightweight, making it a great option for those with oily or combination skin. (For reference, I have neutral skin.) One of the standout aspects of this ampoule is how well it absorbs. It settles into the skin with a firming, bouncy finish—almost like it’s creating a protective layer on the surface. This makes my skin feel deeply nourished without any greasiness. Another major plus: it’s a functional skincare product that remains gentle. If you have sensitive skin but are looking for an effective formula to improve texture, fine lines, and overall skin resilience, this is a fantastic choice. It feels soothing while still delivering noticeable improvements in skin firmness and hydration over time. Overall, I highly recommend this ampoule for anyone looking for a well-balanced formula that hydrates, firms, and revitalizes without irritating the skin!

avis.titre: Impressive Ingredients, Absorbs Quickly And Feels Great But Not For Vegans!
avis.texte: I'm a Massage Therapist. My training included learning just how much the skin absorbs so I'm quite an ingredient snob when it comes to anything that goes on my (or my client's) skin. One thing I have to say up front: the ingredients are some of the best I've seen in awhile. When reading ingredients, note that they are listed in order of the percentage of the volume that they represent. The first ingredients are plant extracts, followed by Aloe and then 2 more plant extracts. That right there tells me that this product is something I want to know more about. See photo for ingredients. A few things including Glycerin follow. I'm honestly not a fan of glycerin because it's often used as a cheap way to fill a product. In my experience Glycerin just sits on the skin and if there's too much it makes the skin feel tacky to me. The amount in this is *just* borderline for my liking. I can feel it on my skin but not to a point where it bothers me. The last ingredient (with many in between) is Benzyl Alcohol. Once again this is often abused as a cheap way to make a product feel like it's drying/absorbing when all it's doing is drying the skin. The amount here is just enough to help as a necessary carrier ingredient and not a cheap filler. So what is this c-PDRN stuff? This is a new one for me so I did some research and learned that this is a DNA fraction extracted from the reproductive organs of male wild Salmon so this is not something Vegans would want to use.
